findings.text: The first review found one uncaught mutation (hardcoding current_gate='green' survived a narrow fixture gap; shipped code correct). Closed before ship and self-verified non-tautological: added a red-standing selftest case (latest gate event failed -> current_gate red, for both the reader and the dashboard), confirmed it FAILS when current_gate is hardcoded green. Mutation coverage now complete for the rendered figures.

summary: X4 (WARP-0404, metrics dashboard) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review: pass_with_notes, gate GREEN, no-drift confirmed independently (the reviewer reimplemented gate_pass_rate, regression_health, and verdict_counts and they equalled the dashboard/compute output on the real events.jsonl and synthetic streams), HTML self-contained (no external asset/script/link/network), stdlib only. Seven of eight mutations caught on first review; the one gap (hardcoded current_gate) was closed pre-ship with a red-standing selftest case, self-verified to fail under the mutation, so the rendered figures are now fully non-tautological. Proportionate (a rendering layer over the single-source reader, no bespoke service); both metrics.py/dashboard.py copies byte-identical; generic; ASCII. proof_digest recomputed via validate.py.
